source: Environment Agency NaFRA2 Risk of Flooding from Rivers and Sea (rofrs_4band, field risk_band), read from Oxfordshire County Council's ArcGIS mirror of the EA layer (https://mymaps2.oxfordshire.gov.uk/server/rest/services/Third_Party/Environment/MapServer/26); the EA itself serves this dataset only as WMS. Clipped to lon -1.40..-1.15, lat 51.68..51.84, simplified (~4 m), parts and holes under 400 m2 dropped, bands made non-overlapping (each area keeps its highest band).
